summary: An unemployed person is short with family and friends and has more arguments than before.
realLife: A survey of unemployed adults found more stress, a sense of lost identity, and a large share reporting more conflicts with family and friends than usual.
sources: Pew Research Center, Unemployed Americans are feeling the emotional strain of job loss (2021): https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2021/02/10/unemployed-americans-are-feeling-the-emotional-strain-of-job-loss-most-have-considered-changing-occupations/
inGame: a person's mood and ties (friend, relative) after a job-ended event; needs: stress and identity trackers

turns.summary: The person stops answering calls rather than arguing.
turns.writesBack: ties cool over weeks; a journal note
